title: Photos
description: A slideshow of your own photos, Immich, Unsplash, Pexels, or NASA's or Wikimedia's picture of the day. Put it in Background to show it behind the other modules.

enum_titles: NASA: Astronomy Picture of the Day
source.title: Source
source.description: Where the photos come from. The settings for the other sources are left as they are.

photos.title: Photos
photos.description: They are shrunk to the mirror's screen on your phone before they're sent, without their location, and they aren't in backups.

immich_url.title: Address
immich_url.description: Your Immich server, as you open it in a browser at home.

immich_key.title: API Key
immich_key.description: In Immich: your account → Account Settings → API Keys → New API Key.

immich_mode.title: Photos
immich_mode.description: Which of your Immich photos to show.

immich_album.title: Album ID
immich_album.description: For An album: open the album in Immich, the ID is the last part of the address.

order.title: Order
order.description: By date taken uses the date the mirror puts first in an uploaded photo's name.

unsplash_key.title: Access Key
unsplash_key.description: From unsplash.com/developers: New Application, then its Access Key.

unsplash_query.title: Search
unsplash_query.description: Words for the photos, like nature or northern lights. Empty: any photo.

unsplash_collections.title: Collections
unsplash_collections.description: Collection IDs, separated by commas, instead of a search.

pexels_query.title: Search
pexels_query.description: Words for the photos. Empty: Pexels' own picks.

orientation.title: Orientation
orientation.description: Only photos of this shape (Pexels: with a search only), to match your screen.

nasa_key.title: API Key
nasa_key.description: Optional, from api.nasa.gov. Without one a shared demo key is used, which is often enough.

interval.title: Seconds per Photo
interval.description: How long each photo is shown. Unsplash: 90 at least. The pictures of the day change once a day.

fit.title: Photo Size
fit.description: Whole photo: all of it, with black (glass) beside it. Fill the screen: fills the screen (in Background) or the box, the edges cropped.

vignette.title: Darker Edges
vignette.description: Darkens the photo towards the edges, so the other modules' text stays readable over it. Brightness: the Opacity setting below.
